card.name: Patient words before a condition clause
card.fires_on: Words like patients, patient, to, who are, or in that name a patient group, just before a clause that says which patients the warning applies to. It appears in warnings and precautions about infection, vaccines, pregnancy or stopping treatment.

modes.label: Patient group noun
modes.description: The word patient(s) right before a who-clause or at-risk description.
modes.example: Consider empiric anti-fungal therapy in<< patients>> at risk for invasive fungal infections who develop

modes.label: Linking word inside the group description
modes.description: A small word like to, been, are, not or or inside the description of who is affected.
modes.example: Permanently discontinue in patients who<< are>> unable to tolerate XALKORI after

card.plain: It fires on the spot in a warning where the text is about to say which type of patient the advice applies to.
